text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Mejiro Palmer was injured,
I quickly brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oof...
Might've messed up just a teeny bit.
choice_data_list: Let's take a break for a while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you know, I wonder about that.
Well, it's just my own personal opinion, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"While everyone was practicing super hard,
there was a time I just sat around doing nothing because 'it was too tough'—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So when it comes to the real race, running with
a truly free heart... honestly, feels kinda tough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I can't move at all.
...Even if it's just little by little, shouldn't I be doing what I can?
choice_data_list: Let's heal up properly so you can run freely again.
...Maybe I'll keep going for a little longer.
...Shall we keep going for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I can't move at all.
...Even if it's just little by little, shouldn't I be doing what I can?
choice_data_list: Let's heal up properly so you can run freely again.
...Maybe I'll keep going for a little longer.
...Shall we keep going for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right.
Sorry, I guess I was rushing things a bit."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Still... wanting to do something and being unable to move really is frustrating, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her shoulders slumped in defeat,
Mejiro Palmer headed back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Alright, time to warm up again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: One, two, three—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, ow-ow-ow-ow!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Oh crap...!
Did I push it past the point of no return...!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
Maybe I shouldn't have stuck my nose in."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it hurts even when bent slowly,
the injury must be quite severe after all.
I decided to have her focus entirely on resting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Alright! Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If it's just light training, I can totally handle it! Of course, I'll be careful not to make my injury worse!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright! Guess it's time to do my best~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while avoiding putting strain
on the injured area, she completed
a session of light training.
